WARRIORS_ELO = 1657

STDEV = 200
NTRIALS = 10000
nSuccess = 0
for i in range(NTRIALS):
  w = stats.norm.rvs(WARRIORS_ELO, STDEV)
  o = stats.norm.rvs(OPPONENT_ELO, STDEV)
  if w > o: nSuccess += 1
print("Warriors sampled win fraction",
